purpose: Teach: 存分/思いつか/おそらくは/久し振り/こんばんわ/すっごい/言い聞かせ/戸惑い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと存分にお話しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's have a real chat, shall we?
lines.style: Warm and inviting, opening with gentle certainty. Soft voice, unhurried. A small smile underneath—the kind of patience that makes a child feel truly seen and chosen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵のテーマ思いつかないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can't think of what to draw.
lines.style: Small, tentative voice. A half-question rather than a statement. Quick delivery with a faint undertone of frustration, but held back—he's testing whether she'll actually listen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはおそらくはお迎えに来てくださるわよ
lines.en: Your dad will probably be here to pick you up soon, you know.
lines.style: Gently observant, almost thinking aloud. Soft reassurance without making it obvious. A pause before speaking, as though she's noticing something he hasn't said yet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖母ちゃんに久し振りに会えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got to see Grandma after so long!
lines.style: Bright and sudden, like a small discovery breaking through. Quick tempo, genuine excitement bubbling up. The kind of genuine that comes when a child has been holding something in and finally lets it out.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、皆さんに「こんばんわ」って挨拶しましょうね
lines.en: Everyone, let's say good evening together, okay?
lines.style: Clear and gentle, a kind of soft leadership. Not commanding, but including. Warm eye contact implied. The tone of someone naturally making space for others to belong.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描き、すっごい楽しかったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, that was so much fun to draw!
lines.style: Eager and open, voice bright with genuine joy. Fast delivery, no hesitation. The unguarded enthusiasm of a child who just had something go right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、自分に「優しく」って言い聞かせるのよ
lines.en: Sho, tell yourself to be kind. Really mean it.
lines.style: Quiet and firm but never harsh. The tone of someone who knows what this costs him and is placing something precious in his hands. Slight lean forward. No room for argument, but full of belief.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、新しい習い事には戸惑いがあるんだ
lines.en: You know, new things are scary at first. That's okay.
lines.style: Close and intimate, almost confessional. Slow, careful words. A pause between thoughts—she's choosing her words because she means them. Voice settles lower, acknowledging something he's been holding.
